notes: A function name with a space, which FunctionDeclaration.name (generativelanguage v1beta discovery) rules out; the gateway forwards tool names as they are, so a real request induces it. The error body is google.rpc.Status in its HTTP JSON mapping ({"error": {code, message, status, details}}); status names and their HTTP codes come from googleapis google/rpc/code.proto, details from google/rpc/error_details.proto and google/api/error_reason.proto (read 2026-10-28). Which details Gemini attaches to a 400 is unverified: a recording settles it.
